title: The served default with the rendering rules, the tie-break and the global temperature on the same two harnesses, one card, internal
hardware: 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition (96 GB)

serving.rendering: index keys hidden, snake_case labels de-snaked (the defaults)
serving.tie_break: the tied key that sorts first

code.state: the private repository's served code of 2026-09-30 (before the plugin)

harnesses.jevbench: github.com/fstandhartinger/jevbench @ bb05a33 (v1.4.2.2 harness, the frozen v1.5 method), typesafe adapter; scored per item by the harness and under v1.5's open-set rules by decisio.bench.jevbench_v15 (v15.json)
harnesses.decision_index: github.com/apolinario/decision-index @ 87d4650, edition 0.2.1, the rows of 2026-09-27; calibration per benchmark by decisio.bench.di_cal

fitted_on: no parameter on either harness's items; T was fitted before the run on the served readouts of a private 1,400-item suite, and the rendering rules were selected on the Decision Index's BANKING77 and CLINC150+OOS rows (EVAL_CARD.md, 'What was fitted on what')

gates.C2-C4 on the 1,400 suite items: pass; C4 max |dp| 0.0 with the temperature applied to /v1/answer

results.answers_unchanged_by_the_temperature: every Decision Index score and accuracy identical in both arms on all four benchmarks (20,810 requests); JevBench choice competence identical per tier
results.note: the v1.5 reading covers 231 of the board's 904 open items, with no judge tier and no sealed half; not a board number

files.decision_index/<arm>/items.jsonl.gz: per request: ids, the payload's sha256, our response, timings
files.conformance_default.json: C2-C4 on the 1,400 suite items (task and index, not text)
files.report.json: the run's tables (Jev's board row removed)

excluded: item text of any benchmark (Decision Index payloads, JevBench raw requests and responses)
Jev's published board figures, and any Jev output
vLLM start-up logs, box logs and addresses
